name: University of Canterbury
feeMethod: Publishes a tuition fee estimate per 120 points (a full-time year) for each degree, used as is. The Master of Professional Accounting has one programme fee, divided by its 1.5 years.
description: The University of Canterbury is a public research university in Christchurch, established in 1873 as Canterbury College. It has about 20,800 students across six faculties including engineering, science and business.
whyIncluded: UC offers articulation pathways for engineering diploma holders from Singapore's five polytechnics into its Bachelor of Engineering (Hons), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360, UNESCO data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for one student sharing a flat, over 12 months: rent, power, internet, food, transport, phone and insurance. Excludes bond, furnishings, books, parking and clothing.
livingCosts.notes: UC 'Flatting - estimate of costs' (page dated 15 July 2026; single person sharing a 4-bedroom house in Ilam), weekly x 52/12. Housing: rent $200 + power $20 + internet $8/wk. Food: $145/wk. Transport: $25/wk. Personal: mobile phone $8 + contents and liability insurance $10 + other/incidentals $20/wk. UC's weekly total is $436. Excludes one-off and annual extras (bond $800, rent in advance $400, furnishings $750, books $750, parking $560, clothing $750). UC's halls estimate is $525/wk.

programmes.notes: 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points (BDataSc, 360 points = 3 years); actual fee depends on courses. UC also publishes 2028: $46,125. Compulsory = Student Services Levy for on-campus study, $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 in 2026 (2027 rate not yet published). Excludes insurance. Rows from Wayback captures of UC's International tuition fees page (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/international-tuition-fees), which then listed per-qualification estimates: capture 20240806165814 lists 2024 and 2025 estimates, capture 20250401065822 repeats them unchanged and adds 2026 ('Bachelor of Data Science (BDataSc) - 360 points 2024 tuition fee estimate: $38,981 per 120 points 2025 tuition fee estimate: $40,500 per 120 points 2026 tuition fee estimate: $42,080 per 120 points'; the 2026 figure matches the existing 2026 row). Compulsory = Student Services Levy $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40 for both 2024 and 2025 (UC Calendar 2024/2025 Fees and Fines Regulations, as used for UC's other 2024/2025 rows). Corrects the earlier note that no earlier per-qualification estimates are available. Fix 2026-10-15: moved to feeYear 2028: UC's page (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/international-tuition-fees/bachelors, read 2026-10-15) publishes the 2028 tuition fee estimate NZ$46,125 beside 2027 (NZ$43,930), so 2028 is now the current record and 2027 is a feeHistory row. Compulsory fees are now the 2027 Student Services Levy, $10.71/point x 120 = $1,285.40 (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/student-services-levy, read 2026-10-15; the 2028 levy is not yet published), on the current record and the 2027 row; the older sentence above saying the 2027 levy was 'not yet published' is superseded.

programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students in the 2-year master's; the actual fee depends on courses chosen. Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: Psychology is a major of UC's Master of Science (240 points, 2 years: coursework then thesis; major list on canterbury.ac.nz/study/academic-study/qualifications/master-of-science). 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points for the MSc ($47,600); same fee and history as the Master of Science entry. 2026 = $45,300; 2028 published as $50,000. UC's Master of Organisational Psychology is offered only online through UC Online, so it is not used. Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Levy $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 (2027 not yet published). Excludes insurance. 2024 and 2025 rows copied from the Master of Science entry: UC Calendar Fees and Fines Regulations Schedule 1 Part C international fee band 4 (Science, Health Sciences) postgraduate rate per 120 points; SSL then $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40. Fix 2026-10-15: moved to feeYear 2028: UC's page (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/international-tuition-fees/masters, read 2026-10-15) publishes the 2028 tuition fee estimate NZ$50,000 beside 2027 (NZ$47,600), so 2028 is now the current record and 2027 is a feeHistory row. Compulsory fees are now the 2027 Student Services Levy, $10.71/point x 120 = $1,285.40 (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/student-services-levy, read 2026-10-15; the 2028 levy is not yet published), on the current record and the 2027 row; the older sentence above saying the 2027 levy was 'not yet published' is superseded.

programmes.name: Master of Professional Accounting
programmes.feeBasis: Canterbury's 2028 Master of Professional Accounting special programme fee of NZ$62,400 for 180 points, spread over a 1.5-year programme. 2027 would be NZ$59,400 (NZ$39,600 a year).
programmes.summary: Programme fee for the 180-point, 17-month course, paid at the start and spread here over 1.5 years. Student services levy is included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: UC international masters fee page (read 2026-10-15) lists the MPA Special Programme Fee NZ$62,400 for 180 points in 2028 (59,400 in 2027, 56,850 in 2026); divided by 1.5 years (17-month programme, semester 1 or 2 start) = 41,600 / 39,600 / 37,900, same method as the existing MBA row. Compulsory = Student Services Levy 2027 $10.71/pt x 120 = 1,285.40 (2028 not yet published; 2026 $1,236.00). 2025 row: UC Calendar 2025 Fees and Fines Regulations Schedule 1 Part C international fee band 2 (Accountancy, Business) postgraduate $36,400 per 120 points, the MPA (180 points) not being in the Part D special programme list; 1.5 x 36,400 = 54,600 total / 1.5 = 36,400; SSL then $9.17/pt x 120 = 1,100.40. 2024 row deliberately omitted: the 2024 MPA was a 240-point programme (UC Calendar 2024) so a per-120-point band would not describe a 1.5-year programme; the 2024 band was $35,000 per 120 points. UC special programme fees are paid at the start for the whole qualification (hence cohortLocked).
